scope: Revised designs only. v1 remains historical. No dataset construction, model run or evaluator calibration has been executed.

experiments.hypothesis: Required native video interfaces, trainable paths and reload work on available hardware.
experiments.success_condition: Pin identities and verify actual resources; no assumed 3B memory guarantee.

experiments.hypothesis: Normative and observed events can be annotated without source or future leakage.
experiments.success_condition: Separate T/P/O and G0/G1 information; same source group and counterfactual variants stay in one split.

experiments.hypothesis: RGB event observation rejects controlled errors and reports ambiguity.
experiments.success_condition: CPU-compatible calibration; proposed coverage 0.90 and false acceptance upper95 0.05 require independent groups and frozen validation thresholds.

experiments.hypothesis: Sampling and codec preserve the events needed for the task.
experiments.success_condition: Resolve information loss before interpreting learning failure; no oracle-boundary inference windows.

experiments.hypothesis: Native generators show repeatable observable failures in the specified task.
experiments.success_condition: Zero-shot is context only; use development media for EVAL-02 and retain all failures.

experiments.hypothesis: The evaluator remains calibrated on actual generator outputs across baseline families.
experiments.success_condition: If automation fails, human labels remain primary; never silently discard unmatched model outputs.

experiments.hypothesis: H1: relevant history improves actual event identity and first-error judgments.
experiments.success_condition: Do not require distinct next actions for histories with the same legal continuation state.

experiments.hypothesis: Single-task objectives and data paths can fit a tiny development set.
experiments.success_condition: Fix masking and time handling before interpreting model limitations; no generalization claim.

experiments.hypothesis: H0: a meaningful gap remains after fair ordinary domain adaptation and strong structured execution.
experiments.success_condition: If simple solutions satisfy the intended application, stop adding complexity; zero-shot gain alone cannot establish mechanism novelty.

experiments.hypothesis: H2 precursor: event information has causal leverage on visible execution.
experiments.success_condition: Separate identity, planning and execution; O is a privileged upper-bound table, not T evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: Minimal shared CE and video training establishes a reproducible joint baseline.
experiments.success_condition: Match exposure and compute separately; no credit for extra labels without controls.

experiments.hypothesis: H2: spatial event identity and targeted execution supervision improve actual RGB beyond M0 and simple controls.
experiments.success_condition: Main gain must exist on T free rollout, with glyph/style safeguards; no proof from teacher-forced steps alone.

experiments.hypothesis: Changing localized event state produces the predicted local execution effect.
experiments.success_condition: Use realistic perturbations for main attribution; attention plots or self-consistency alone are insufficient.

experiments.hypothesis: H3: parameter sharing adds value with the same event interface and supervision.
experiments.success_condition: Report a negative H3 honestly; H2 can remain a method result without a sharing claim.

experiments.hypothesis: H4: actual RGB feedback improves recovery beyond plan state and equal-cost retries.
experiments.success_condition: Optional; no hidden rewriting of published past; does not gate SO-04.

experiments.hypothesis: H5: the locked method improves complete T generation and transfers across independent content/style/source axes.

experiments.success_condition: Dependency completion records decisions, not necessarily positive H3; REC-01 is not required. Freeze before test.

experiments.hypothesis: Event-aware compute improves cost at fixed verified process and appearance quality.
